text:
maya (Docs): Quick heads up — I'm opening a PR with the final 'What's new' copy + known-issues for this sprint. Need a fast sanity check before I merge.
jon (Product): Thanks — can we add a one-liner about the adaptive routing fallback behavior? It's surfaced in the support queue a bit.
maya (Docs): yep. Drafting that now. Thinking: "Added adaptive routing fallback to cheaper model variants when capacity is constrained (may alter latency under load). See known issues." Too wordy?
sam (Eng): fine, maybe: "Adaptive routing now falls back to compatible model variants under high load; latency/cost may vary." Keeps it short for the whatsnew banner.
jen (Release): Also call out SDK snippet changes. We changed the streaming API in the JS SDK — need examples updated, otherwise customers hit deprecation warnings.
maya (Docs): good catch. @jen can you paste the minimal JS snippet we should include?
jen (Release): paste below — minimal streaming example we want in the docs:
```js
const stream = client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwd-7b', input: 'Summarize the PR' });
for await (const chunk of stream) console.log(chunk.text);
```
jen (Release): put this under "Client streaming" and add a note: "Use .stream for lower-latency token streaming; check version >= 1.4.0"
maya (Docs): adding that snippet and the version note. Also adding a short migration tip for users on 1.3.x.
jon (Product): We should also include a brief known issue about ephemeral link TTLs — some published docs links were expiring earlier than expected after the docs CDN migration. Any status?
sam (Eng): that's the CDN config issue we patched last night. Public links now default to 14-day TTL, but internal publishing flow still uses 1-hour preview links. I'll push a follow-up PR to normalize.
maya (Docs): I'll add a known-issue entry: "Documentation preview links (1-hour TTL) may expire when shared externally — workaround: publish to stable page or request longer TTL from eng." Short and actionable.
jen (Release): Also tag the release notes with the internal ticket: ENG-2149 and DOCS-462 so support can correlate.
maya (Docs): added `(ENG-2149, DOCS-462)` to the known-issues line.
docs-bot: PR 4321 opened by maya: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321|view PR> :spiral_note_pad:
jon (Product): Quick QA — can we add a one-sentence impact line under the whatsnew banner for enterprise customers mentioning Dedicated capacity is unaffected?
maya (Docs): good call. Adding: "Dedicated deployments unaffected by routing fallback; only hosted API may route to variants under peak load."
sam (Eng): LGTM. After PR lands, I'll send a small deploy to staging so you can test the sample snippet render and the whatsnew banner.
maya (Docs): Perfect. Targeting merge in 2 hours. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
